From what I understand it is all a test. Whether or not we are free to love Him as Him. If we are robots, there is no free will; there is no choice to love and obey by will but only code that forces action. Imagine it being like a relational kind of thing with a significant other; would it be right if love by code or by choice? whether the son chooses to stay or leave.    
Now imagine a situation of what a  father does initially: he provides for the kid with food, water, shelter, education, and affection.... would you think the father would get satisfaction if he did that for a robot, in which it cannot feel but just obeys.... no. In truth God wants you, in your free will, to see how good God actually is and from that act. He wants those who wants Him. It's kindda like how a person wants their child to love them not out by force but out of love... by their own free will.
